action.prompt:
A new meeting transcript file was just created in the samples/ directory. Please:
1. Read the transcript file that was just created
2. Send its content to POST /api/analyze with a meaningful title derived from the filename
3. Display the structured results including: decisions made, action items with owners and deadlines, and participants
4. Save the JSON response to samples/output/ directory with the same base filename but a .json extension

If the server is not running, remind the user to start it with: npm start (in the meeting-tracker directory)
